_what_this_is: DD-211. Rungs a knob's `overridable_by` OFFERS that no database reader can answer with, because no reader names them in `p_scopes`. Each one is a settings control a person can set and nothing will honour. This list is a RATCHET: `pnpm check:knob-database-consumers` fails on any rung NOT listed here, and fails just as loudly when a listed one has been FIXED and left behind, so it can only shrink. Adding a line needs the sentence that says why it is still owed and who owes it.
_how_to_clear_one: Teach the reader to name the rung (what DD-211 did for `agent` on records.confirmation.agent_write_born_confirmed: platform._stamp_actor_tier now passes {"kind":"agent"} beside the table), or take the rung out of that knob's `overridable_by` until a reader does. Then delete the line here.
